shots.scene: 欣欣站在一间实验室门口，手搭凉棚张望
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a laboratory doorway, shading its eyes with one paw and looking around curiously.
shots.narration: 这一课：新实验室里，危害藏在哪？
overlay: 新实验室的危害在哪里

shots.section_title: 进入新实验室的第一天
shots.scene: 阿杰背着书包，第一次走进一间明亮的实验室
shots.prompt_en: The young male student with a backpack walks into a bright university laboratory for the first time, looking around.
shots.narration: 今天是阿杰进新实验室的第一天。
overlay: 进入新实验室的第一天

shots.section_title: 进入新实验室的第一天
shots.scene: 阿杰望着满墙的试剂架和仪器，眼睛发直
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stares at shelves of reagent bottles with blank labels and several instruments, looking overwhelmed.
shots.narration: 瓶瓶罐罐、大小仪器，看得他眼花。

shots.scene: 老周带着阿杰沿实验台走，指着通风柜
shots.prompt_en: The older man walks the young male student along the benches and points at a fume hood.
shots.narration: 老周带他转一圈，一一指出危险的地方。

shots.scene: 老周指着墙角的气瓶，阿杰认真点头
shots.prompt_en: The older man points at a gas cylinder chained to the wall in the corner; the young male student nods seriously.
shots.narration: 这里有气瓶，那边有化学品柜。

shots.scene: 阿杰手里的本子上画了一个大问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a blank notebook with a big question mark icon floating above it.
shots.narration: 可老周不会天天在身边，还能问谁？

shots.scene: 欣欣出现在阿杰身边，指向实验室四周
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot appears beside the young male student and gestures around the laboratory.
shots.narration: 其实，实验室自己就会告诉你。

shots.scene: 实验室门口挂着一块安全信息牌，牌面只有图标
shots.prompt_en: A laboratory door with a safety information board beside it, showing only hazard pictograms and a phone icon. No people.
shots.narration: 先看门口的安全信息牌。

shots.scene: 信息牌放大：危险类别图标、人像图标、电话图标
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the safety information board: a row of hazard pictograms, a person icon and a telephone icon. No people.
shots.narration: 上面写着危险类别、负责人和应急电话。

shots.scene: 阿杰在信息牌前用手机拍照
shots.prompt_en: The young male student photographs the safety information board with a blank phone.
shots.narration: 把负责人和应急电话记下来。

shots.scene: 门上并排贴着生物危害、电离辐射、激光警示标志
shots.prompt_en: A laboratory door with a biohazard warning sign, an ionizing radiation warning sign and a laser warning sign side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 再看门上和设备上的安全标志。

shots.scene: 黄色三角警告、红圈禁止、蓝圆指令三种标志
shots.prompt_en: Three sign shapes in a row: a yellow warning triangle, a red prohibition circle, and a blue mandatory circle. No people.
shots.narration: 黄三角警告，红圈禁止，蓝圆必须做。

shots.scene: 气瓶上的颜色和标签，旁边有压缩气体图标
shots.prompt_en: A gas cylinder with colored shoulder bands and a compressed gas pictogram label. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶颜色、仪器标签，也在提示危险。

shots.scene: 小研举起一瓶试剂，标签上有红边菱形象形图
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up a reagent bottle whose blank label shows red-bordered diamond hazard pictograms.
shots.narration: 化学品瓶上的标签，是第一张危险说明。

shots.scene: 火焰、腐蚀、骷髅、感叹号四个GHS象形图
shots.prompt_en: Four GHS hazard pictograms in red diamonds: a flame, corrosion, a skull and crossbones, and an exclamation mark. No people.
shots.narration: 看象形图和信号词，就知道危险类型。

shots.scene: 小研从文件夹里取出一份空白的安全技术说明书
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student takes a blank safety data sheet out of a binder labeled with a book icon.
shots.narration: 更详细的，查安全技术说明书SDS。

shots.scene: SDS页面放大，几个小图标：防护、急救、泄漏
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a blank data sheet with small icons: goggles and gloves, a first aid cross, and a spill drop. No people.
shots.narration: 防护、急救、泄漏处理，里面都有。

shots.section_title: 安全手册、规程和风险评估
shots.scene: 书架上一本空白的实验室安全手册和一叠规程
shots.prompt_en: A shelf with a blank laboratory safety manual and a stack of blank procedure binders. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室安全手册和操作规程要读。
overlay: 安全手册、规程和风险评估

shots.section_title: 安全手册、规程和风险评估
shots.scene: 阿杰翻看空白的风险评估表，旁边是放大镜图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reads a blank risk assessment form with a magnifier icon beside it.
shots.narration: 风险评估记录，写明每项实验的危险。

shots.section_title: 安全手册、规程和风险评估
shots.scene: 王老师递给阿杰一本空白的化学品台账
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands the young male student a blank chemical inventory logbook.
shots.narration: 化学品台账，告诉你这里存了什么。

shots.section_title: 认清应急设施和逃生路线
shots.scene: 洗眼器、紧急喷淋、灭火器标志排成一行
shots.prompt_en: An eyewash sign, an emergency shower sign and a fire extinguisher sign in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 洗眼器、喷淋、灭火器，先找到位置。
overlay: 认清应急设施和逃生路线

shots.section_title: 认清应急设施和逃生路线
shots.scene: 安全出口标志下，绿色箭头指向走廊
shots.prompt_en: A green emergency exit sign above a door, with a green arrow pointing down a corridor. No people.
shots.narration: 疏散路线和安全出口，也要走一遍。

shots.section_title: 认清应急设施和逃生路线
shots.scene: 王老师在培训室给新生讲课，阿杰举手提问
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches new students in a training room; the young male student raises his hand to ask a question.
shots.narration: 入室培训和考核，帮你把这些串起来。

shots.scene: 老周拍拍阿杰肩膀，指着信息牌
shots.prompt_en: The older man pats the young male student on the shoulder and points at the safety information board.
shots.narration: 看不懂的，随时问负责人和安全员。

shots.section_title: 本课不能代替本实验室规程
shots.scene: 一张空白课程卡片和一本更大的空白规程手册
shots.prompt_en: A small blank course card next to a larger blank procedure binder with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 这门课不能代替本实验室的规程。
overlay: 本课不能代替本实验室规程

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现信息牌、标志、标签三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of an information board, a warning sign and a bottle label.
shots.narration: 门口看信息牌，墙上看标志。

shots.scene: SDS、手册、风险评估表三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a blank data sheet, a blank manual, and a blank risk assessment checklist. No people.
shots.narration: 瓶上看标签，细节查SDS和手册。

shots.scene: 洗眼器和安全出口图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an eyewash station and an emergency exit sign side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 应急设施和出口，第一天就认清。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰站在安全信息牌前挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the young male student wave goodbye in front of the laboratory safety information board.
shots.narration: 危害看得见，安全才心安，下次见！
